name: EPIC 201684954
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 15.6 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,640 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.86 solar masses and 15.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,299 K at its surface.
